title: Pockels effect
description: An electric field changes how strongly certain crystals bend light, in step with the field. Crystals that switch light this way put data onto optical fibres and fire the pulses of many lasers.
effect: an electric field changes how a crystal bends light
pickWhy: Named effect, clear job (switching light), already behind real inventions the deck lacks.
edbDesc: Produces birefringence in an optical medium induced by a constant or varying electric field. Used to make Pockels cells, which are voltage-controlled wave plates.
